title: Cherry Pickup II
description: Two robots start at top corners (0,0) and (0,c-1), moving down to row R-1, collecting maximum cherries.

steps.note: Starting at row 0, robots at col 0 and 2. Cherries collected: 3 + 1 = 4.
Robots move to row 1. Robot 1 to col 1, Robot 2 to col 1.
Since c1 == c2, only count cell [1, 1] once (5 cherries). Total = 4 + 5 = 9.
Base case reached (r == rows), returning total collected: 9.
